subject: MAP: Onboarding → Decision - draft MAP & demo cadence
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Soto <alex@cindercloud.com>, ProductOps <ops@cindercloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Onboarding → Decision - draft MAP & demo cadence

Hi Alex / CinderCloud team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short slide deck that lays out a two-week evaluation cadence we think will demonstrate Redwood’s fit for your inference workload.

Attached: CinderCloud-MAP-template.gdoc (editable) and Demo-Cadence-Slides.gslides. I also included a short SOC2 summary for your security team to review.

What I’m asking for from you this week:
- Confirm the internal stakeholders who will own acceptance criteria and sign-off.
- Indicate whether a 2-week pilot or a longer proof-of-concept is preferable for you.
- Pick two 30-minute time slots for a kickoff + environment review (we’ll do a mock evaluation run during that session).

Key acceptance items called out in the MAP draft:
- Latency targets (p50/p95) for your traffic profile
- Data handling and privacy controls in our private deployments
- Success signals for a pilot (sample throughput, end-to-end demo with real prompt set)

I’ve pre-populated owners and a suggested timeline in the doc — feel free to edit directly. If you prefer, I can lock the doc and we’ll co-edit in the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

---
Attachment stubs: CinderCloud-MAP-template.gdoc (Google Doc, editable); Demo-Cadence-Slides.gslides (Google Slides); SOC2-summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Alex Soto <alex@cindercloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, ProductOps <ops@cindercloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Onboarding → Decision - draft MAP & demo cadence

Thanks Priya — appreciate the fast turnaround and the editable doc. Quick answers from our side:

Stakeholders (please loop these people into the MAP):
- Evelyn Park (evelyn.park@cindercloud.com) — CTO (final technical sign-off)
- Daniel Morris (dan.morris@cindercloud.com) — SRE (performance & infra)
- Lena Kim (lena.kim@cindercloud.com) — Product (acceptance criteria / feature fit)
- Procurement: contracts@cindercloud.com (we’ll include later for legal/terms)

We’d like to move quickly; a 2-week pilot sounds right to validate latency & throughput with our sample prompt set. Before kickoff, our security lead will want a slightly expanded SOC2 summary and an inventory of data flows during the pilot (what gets logged, retention defaults).

Available kickoff windows (PST) this week:
- Tue 22 Jun: 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 23 Jun: 09:30–10:00

If you can grab one of those, we’ll get the internal stakeholders invited. Also — is there a short list of test prompts/results we should prepare and upload to the doc?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Soto | Head of Product Ops
CinderCloud
alex@cindercloud.com

Cc: Alex Soto <alex@cindercloud.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Onboarding → Decision - draft MAP & demo cadence

Looping in a couple of teammates to own the technical and onboarding pieces. Priya — thanks for driving the draft. A few quick notes: 

- Marissa, can you take point on the pilot onboarding checklist and the inventory doc that Alex asked for (SOC2 + data flow)? If you want, I’ve started a short template in the MAP under "security & compliance".
- Jonas, we’ll need you to author the evaluation runbook section (sample prompts, measurement commands, load profile). I’ll tag in a recommended p50/p95 measurement harness.

Alex — we can deliver an expanded SOC2 inventory and a straightforward prompt-upload template before the kickoff. Priya, can you propose a final kickoff slot from Alex’s options? I recommend Tue 22 Jun 15:00–15:30 PST so the SRE and Product folks have time to join.

Thanks — I’ll also prepare a short internal checklist for the first 48 hours of the pilot (keys, test user, log access scope).

—Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
